audioPreview.title: Hear the difference
audioPreview.description: Toggle between solo and two-person formats to experience natural cadence and studio fidelity.
audioPreview.generatedNote: This full episode was generated in 4 minutes without a physical microphone.
audioPreview.soloLineOne: Welcome back to the show. Today we're unpacking autonomous AI agents and what they really mean for the future of knowledge work.
audioPreview.soloLineTwo: The shift is already underway. Small teams can now do work that once took an entire department.
audioPreview.soloLineThree: Let's dive into the tools and ideas changing how we build and collaborate.
audioPreview.conversationLineOne: Welcome back to the show. Today we're unpacking autonomous AI agents and what they really mean for the future of knowledge work.
audioPreview.conversationLineTwo: Thanks for having me, Marcus! It's wild how fast the tooling evolved just in the last six months alone.
audioPreview.conversationLineThree: Let's dive straight into real production workflows and what engineers are running today.

features.conversationsDescription: Real back-and-forth dialogue between Host, Co-host, and Guests. Intelligent dynamic pacing, interjections, pauses, and organic tonal cadence.
features.cloningDescription: Upload 15 seconds of clean audio. Use your real voice or invite remote guests to create their instant digital clone.
features.scriptsDescription: Compelling storytelling with natural cadence, hooks, comedic timing, and emotional cues built directly into markdown.
features.scriptLineOne: So let's address the elephant in the room...
features.scriptLineTwo: Right. Everyone assumes scale is the bottleneck.
features.coverDescription: 3000×3000 Apple Podcast compliant artwork generated automatically.
features.transcriptDescription: Automated timestamped chapters, show notes, and accurate SRT/VTT exports.

TextToSpeech.title: Text to speech
TextToSpeech.placeholder: Write or paste the words you want your voice to say...
TextToSpeech.editorHelp: Add your script or choose a tone below to start with a sample.
TextToSpeech.textRequired: Enter some text to generate speech.
TextToSpeech.startingPointHelp: Pick a tone to fill the editor with an example. You can edit it afterward.
TextToSpeech.chooseVoiceToContinue: Choose a voice in the settings panel to continue.
TextToSpeech.voiceUnavailable: That voice is unavailable. Choose another voice to continue.
TextToSpeech.chooseVoice: Choose the voice you want to use for speech generation.
TextToSpeech.loadVoicesError: Couldn’t load voices. Check your connection and try again.
TextToSpeech.exaggerationHelp: Usually controls expressiveness and emotion in generated speech.
TextToSpeech.exaggerationHigh: Higher values can sound more dramatic.
TextToSpeech.cfgHigh: Higher values make the model follow the prompt more strictly.
TextToSpeech.unnaturalWarning: Very high values can make speech or text sound unnatural.
TextToSpeech.minPHelp: Filters out tokens with extremely low probability.
TextToSpeech.minPHigh: Higher values make output more focused.
TextToSpeech.topPSample: 0.9 = sample from the most likely 90% of probability mass.
TextToSpeech.emptyHistory: Your generated audio will appear here.
